license_scope: Each adapted recording keeps the source license specified in its entry. The audio licenses do not relicense the application code.
selection_policy: Prefer a documented focal individual; reject explicit multi-bird or playback recordings. Select short intervals without other confident species labels. Do not layer, loop, synthesize, or separate birds.
review_limit: Automated screening plus source-note review, not human listening certification. One target species is screened; exactly one physical individual cannot be proved.
